name: Draco Lee
bio:
Draco Lee is a master tattoo artist renowned for his remarkable skill in black & gray, realism, trash polka, and cover-ups. His meticulous attention to detail and artistry is brought to life at Precision Ink International Tattoo Studio, where he ensures every piece is a stunning work of art. Sponsored by CrocArt Tattoo Care, Draco's commitment to excellence solidifies his status as a #crocarteliteartist, and clients leave not only with impressive tattoos but also with admiration for his profound professionalism.
